title: Set console keyboard layout in Arch live environment
summary: Change the keyboard layout in the Arch Linux installation live environment to match your physical keyboard.
prerequisites: Booted into Arch Linux live environment

steps.explain: List available keyboard layouts to find the name of your layout.
steps.expect: A list of available keymap names.

steps.explain: Load the desired keyboard layout. Replace <KEYMAP> with the name found in the previous step (e.g., de-latin1).

placeholders.name: KEYMAP
placeholders.description: Name of the keyboard layout, e.g., de-latin1

steps.expect: No output, but keyboard input should now match the selected layout.
